$schema_note: TYPBOX design tokens. Extracted from frontend/src (index.css, App.tsx, telemetryFeatures.tsx, categoryStyle.ts, uiFonts.ts, statusCard.ts). Values are the defaults of the MONOLITH STANDARD theme unless noted. See DESIGN.md for the intent behind them.

status.error: #fb7185  /* rose-400 text, rose-500/40 border, rose-500/10 fill */

surface.themeShape: Every Surface Theme is a dark/light pair with exactly these 9 keys (SurfacePolarityPalette) plus accentHex and a background pattern. Components only ever read these keys, so swapping a theme never touches layout.

category.rule: User-chosen hex per category. Active = solid fill. Inactive (parked) = hollow ring for swatches, diagonal hatch for bars: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, COLOR 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px).

color.tintedChipRecipe: border COLOR/40 + background COLOR/10 + text COLOR-400 (dark) / COLOR-700 (light)

family.mono: System monospace by default (SF Mono, Consolas, Menlo…); user can swap to one of 44 fonts in uiFonts.ts (JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Geist Mono…).
family.sans: Used only for long prose (descriptions, help text). Follows the chosen UI font when it is marked body:true.

scale.label: 10px  /* the workhorse: panel meta, chips, buttons on desktop */
scale.metric: 24px → 36px at sm  /* text-2xl sm:text-4xl, font-light, tracking-tight; unit label stays 10–12px muted beside it */

typography.case: UPPERCASE for every label, title, button and chip. Sentence case only in prose.
typography.numerals: tabular-nums everywhere a number can change

radius.default: 0  /* panels, buttons, inputs, chips, modals are all square-cornered */
radius.pill: 9999px  /* ONLY status dots, avatars and soft background glows */

border.rule: Structure is drawn with borders, not shadows or fills. Grids of cells use border-t border-l on the wrapper and border-r border-b on each cell so lines never double.

shadow.glow: Accent glows are box-shadow rings / blur-3xl circles at 5% opacity, never drop shadows.

spacing.rowPadding: 12px  /* py-3 rows in the log stream */

layout.workspace: lg: 12-column grid, left col-span-5 (chronometer, session logger, categories, insights), right col-span-7 (analytics, cadence matrix, log stream). Below lg: single column, reordered with order-* so the clock and logger come first.
layout.metricsStrip: 2 columns → 4 at lg, numbered labels '01 / TOTAL LOGGED'
layout.touchTargets: min-h 36–42px on mobile/tablet, collapsing to compact (lg:min-h-0) on desktop

icon.color: Accent (emerald) for the one icon that names a panel or action; otherwise inherits text color.

motion.rowFlash: 2.4s ease-out  /* new log row fades from emerald/22% */
motion.cellPulse: 2.6s ease-in-out infinite  /* today's cadence cell in ambient mode */
motion.reducedMotion: Every decorative animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

textConventions.separator: ' // '  e.g. 'REC // ACTIVE', 'SYNC // Asia/Tokyo', 'PUBLIC GUEST MODE // STANDBY'
textConventions.codes: Short machine-style IDs next to names: THM-01, DIV-03, LV.1,240

surfaceThemes.count: 900 dark/light pairs: 292 archive, 300 pixel-art, 308 NEO SIGNAL (12 of them prestige)
